messages:
Maya: Hey, I got Grafana access but when I try to save edits to dashboards it says 'You need permission to save' — I was added to team 'platform-engineering'. Anyone seen this?
Sasha: Did you get 'Editor' role? Grafana has folder-level perms. Which org/folder are you in? send a screenshot if you can.
Maya: Org: redwood-prod, folder: /devex/dashboards. Screenshot shows: 'You need Editor role or explicit folder write'.
devex-bot: Heads up — invites via Okta group 'devex-readers' are provisioned as Viewer only. We typically add new hires to 'devex-editors' after initial onboarding.
Olivia: Ping @Sasha for group mapping. Also check if you're in the grafana provisioning team (we use that for folder ACLs).
Sasha: I just checked provisioning — your Okta groups are [devex-readers, eng-all]. I can add you to devex-editors but need quick approval from eng-platform. @Mike can you approve?
Mike: Approving — go ahead @Sasha. Also FYI Datadog SSO mapping had a similar issue last week; we had to update SAML attribute mappings (groups -> roles).
Sasha: Done, added devex-editors to your profile. @Maya try logging out and back in.
Maya: Logged out & back in — can save now, thanks! :+1:
Maya: One more thing — Sentry shows an empty project list for me. I expected to see 'redwood-api' and 'console'.
Olivia: Sentry invites are per-project. You should get an invite email per project. Did you sign up with the same email as Okta (maya@redwood.com)?
Maya: I used maya@redwood.com. I don't see any invites in my inbox.
devex-bot: I triggered a manual invite for 'redwood-api' and 'console' to maya@redwood.com. Also you can request project access via `/onboard-sentry` in #devex to speed things up.
Maya: Found the invite in Promotions (ugh), accepted and I can see the issues now.
Maya: Datadog still shows 'no dashboards' though — UI says 'You don't have access to any dashboards in this org'.
Sasha: Datadog uses org/team-level roles. Are you mapped to the 'eng-observability' team in Okta? Also check the region selector (us-east vs eu-west) — dashboards are region-scoped in our setup.
Olivia: I just invited you to eng-observability in Datadog. You should get an email; accept and try again. If SSO mapping fails, go to Datadog -> Manage Access -> Request Access.
Maya: Emails arrived, accepted all. Quick summary for future new hires: Grafana can be Viewer by default (folder-level provisioning), Sentry requires project invites, Datadog needs team/org role. Thanks everyone for the help! :tada:
